async def act(page):
    # Set the Order Status filter to 'Canceled' to filter for cancelled orders
    await page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("combobox", name="Order Status").select_option("Canceled")
    # Click the 'Show Report' button to apply the filter and refresh the report
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report").click()
    # Wait for the report to load after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    import asyncio
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    # Extract and print the text from the main content area to get the report data as-is
    report_text = await page.get_by_role("main").inner_text()
    print(report_text)
